en.headline: Atsuko Okatsuka performs Big Bowl Tour at AsiaWorld-Expo tonight
en.dek: The comedian takes the stage at Runway 11 at 8pm, with seated tickets priced from HK$580 to HK$780.
body: Award-winning comedian Atsuko Okatsuka is scheduled to perform her Big Bowl Tour at AsiaWorld-Expo Runway 11 tonight.
The show starts at 8pm and is fully seated. Tickets range from HK$580 to HK$780 and are available through Ticketflap. The event is organised by Clockenflap Presents Limited and Bohm Presents.

Okatsuka is known for her specials Father and The Intruder as well as viral online videos. Organisers said fans are encouraged to wear bowl-cut wigs. The performance is open to audiences aged 15 and above.

zh.headline: Atsuko Okatsuka今晚於亞洲博覽館上演Big Bowl Tour
zh.dek: 喜劇演員晚上八時在11號館演出，座位票價由580港元至780港元。
body: 獲獎喜劇演員Atsuko Okatsuka今晚將於亞洲國際博覽館11號館（Runway 11）上演其Big Bowl Tour。
演出於晚上八時開始，全場座位。票價由580港元至780港元，可於Ticketflap購買。主辦單位為Clockenflap Presents Limited及Bohm Presents。
Okatsuka以特輯《Father》及《The Intruder》以及網上病毒式影片聞名。主辦方表示鼓勵觀眾佩戴碗形假髮。演出適合15歲或以上觀眾。
